title: A Compact Formula-Aware Spreadsheet Abstraction for Large Language Models
title_zh: 一种面向大语言模型的紧凑型公式感知电子表格抽象

paragraphs.en: 提出紧凑公式感知的电子表格抽象，降低token消耗并提升LLM处理电子表格准确性。 Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to assist spreadsheet users with tasks such as spreadsheet model construction, formula generation, and data analysis, yet their interaction with real-world spreadsheets remains limited by the mismatch between the structure of spreadsheets and the sequential textual representations typically provided to LLMs. We propose a compact formula-aware spreadsheet abstraction that represents large homogeneous ranges through their positions, types, R1C1 formula patterns, and selected boundary values. An efficient algorithm detects and structures these ranges before a textual serialization is supplied to an LLM. The abstraction is provided to the LLM before detailed spreadsheet content is submitted, improving the accuracy and efficiency of spreadsheet processing while reducing token consumption. We evaluate the method on 50 spreadsheet-query cases. The evaluation shows that the abstraction alone was sufficient to answer some queries. When additional spreadsheet content is required, the abstraction reduces the amount of data that must be submitted to the LLM, thereby reducing token consumption. The abstraction layer also improves the reliability and accuracy of spreadsheet processing. We conclude by discussing further techniques for combining spreadsheet static analysis with artificial intelligence to improve the reliability, accuracy, and efficiency of AI assisted spreadsheet tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 提出紧凑的公式感知电子表格抽象，降低token消耗并提升LLM处理电子表格的准确性。大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于协助电子表格用户完成电子表格模型构建、公式生成和数据分析等任务，然而它们与真实世界电子表格的交互仍然受限，原因在于电子表格的结构与通常提供给LLM的顺序文本表示之间存在不匹配。 我们提出一种紧凑的公式感知电子表格抽象，通过位置、类型、R1C1公式模式和选定的边界值来表示大型同质区域。 一种高效算法在将文本序列化提供给LLM之前检测并结构化这些区域。 该抽象在提交详细电子表格内容之前提供给LLM，从而在降低token消耗的同时提升电子表格处理的准确性和效率。 我们在50个电子表格查询用例上评估该方法。 评估表明，仅凭该抽象就足以回答部分查询。 当需要额外的电子表格内容时，该抽象减少了必须提交给LLM的数据量，从而降低token消耗。 该抽象层还提升了电子表格处理的可靠性和准确性。 最后，我们讨论了将电子表格静态分析与人工智能相结合的更多技术，以提升AI辅助电子表格任务的可靠性、准确性和效率。
